Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the correct information from the loaded IMDb page. Although the page clearly displayed "George Raft" and "Johnny Angel" in the visible viewport (confirming he is the star), the agent's subsequent analysis and instructions repeatedly claimed that the page only showed partial content or that the exact role text was missing, leading to redundant reloading of the same URL and an inability to conclude the task. This failure to recognize the visible evidence on the screen constitutes the error that stalled the process.
